  "family": "catalog-storage",
  "version": "1.4.0",
  "operation": "open",
  "absent_storage": "create and return usable",
  "present_storage": "return usable",
  "diagnostics": "Presence inspection does not open storage. A usable report must be backed by a successful open. The opener is suitable for absent-storage diagnostics only when it does not create storage."
}

}
